title: occurrence/v1
description: An occurrence report under Reg. (EU) 376/2014 (spec 04 §3.3; 02 F7 and F11; 01 A8): the request body of the authority's POST /v1/occurrences, sent by USSPs and the ANSP with an ecosystem token of scope occurrences.write. This repository owns it (M14): api/openapi.yaml's OccurrenceReport is the same shape, and the USSP's and ANSP's copies point at this file at a recorded commit. The sender is the token's sub, recorded as reporter_org; reporter.org is informational. (reporter_org, report_ref) is the idempotency key: the same report again answers the first receipt, another report under the same reference is refused with 409 report_ref_conflict. That refusal is permanent: the reference stays held by the report received first, so a sender does not retry it (it would be refused again forever) but records it as failed and, for a different report, sends a new report_ref. A report that differs from the held one only in reporter.person_ref is another report too. reporter.person_ref is the reporter's opaque reference in the sender's system, sent in clear over TLS (M13) and sealed at rest by the authority under a key of its own; it is shown to incident officers only and never exported (376 Art. 16). An operator registration's secret part is dropped at intake (G-04). A report received more than 72 h after became_aware_at is accepted and flagged late, never refused (376 Art. 4(7)-(8)). Members this version does not know are ignored (02 §1).

report_ref.description: The sender's reference of the report; with the sender, the idempotency key. Another report under a reference already held is 409 report_ref_conflict, which is permanent: it is not retried, and a different report takes a new reference.

channel.description: mandatory (376 Art. 4) or voluntary (Art. 5); an operator's report (2019/947 Art. 19(2)) is mandatory.

became_aware_at.description: When the reporter became aware; not before occurred_at. The 72 h run from it.

category.description: The 376 Art. 4(1) class (the UAS classes of 2015/1018 are unverified, spec 08 Q9).

org.description: The reporting organisation's name for itself; the authority records the token's sub.

person_ref.description: The reporter's opaque reference in the sender's system (never a name).

operator_reg.description: The operator registration number; its secret part, if sent, is dropped.

narrative.description: Free text, at most 20000 bytes of UTF-8. It is exported as written: the officer redacts names before filing.

reported_at.description: When the sender recorded the report.

examples.narrative: Synthetic airprox between a UAS and a manned aircraft.
C2 link lost for 40 s over the test area; the UAS flew its contingency procedure and landed.
